text:
You weren't born bad with women. You were trained to be.

Every movie you grew up on taught you one move: worship her, wait your turn, be nice.

That move is the exact opposite of what her instincts respond to.

Attraction runs on rules written 200,000 years ago. Movies rewrote them to sell you tickets.

Nobody ever taught you rule one:
caption:
Rule one is not in a single movie you've ever watched.

Dating isn't romance. It's biology. Old code, still running.

Her instincts don't reward the man who worships. They ignore him.

It was never personal. It was strategy. You just never read the map.

Send this to a man still living in a romance movie.

#selfimprovement #discipline #mindset #masculinity #datingpsychology
